root_cause: The existing read-only owner recommendation accepted a structurally valid old Janitor artifact without checking whether its captured provider observation was recent, allowing stale or future-dated advice to masquerade as current measurement.

observed_evidence.evidence_limitation: One observed job is not a persistent bottleneck, causal critical path, performance SLO or production business outcome.

failed_approaches: Trust a copied hourly JSON snapshot indefinitely
Treat future/unknown sampling timestamps as evidence of healthy live capacity
Make agents re-run or merge CI candidates solely because one stale job was once expensive
fix: Validate a canonical millisecond UTC ISO observed_at independently against the observation clock. Withhold all cross-agent priorities if the time is missing, malformed, future-dated or more than two hours old. Preserve existing >=20 executed jobs/5 runs, exact SHA/run/job provenance, recurrent proof and no-mutation/release constraints.
prevention_rule: No autonomous CI investment, lane writer selection or quality gate relaxation from stale or undated observations; re-observe through the existing single hourly Janitor and compare repeat samples. Never add another scheduler or log. Never treat advisory output as protected merge or deployed-product success.

invariants: 2-hour maximum age after UTC observed_at, including bound equality
no recommendations on stale provider samples
existing single Janitor scheduler and exact-SHA release gate unchanged
no user-facing speedup claim or unauthorized autonomous mutation

terminal_rule: Exact-head Required + CodeQL, protected auto-merge, source and skill readback, real next Janitor confirmation. Broader #4661 remains open; #4655 provider queue ghosts independent.
